audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with their own why-text. Level 2 was Skill and level 3 was Kayle while whys[1] says 'concede the trade' and whys[2] says 'he zones you off CS and chunks you for free'. Levels 4-5 was Kayle while whys[3] says 'it's even', and level 6 was Jayce while whys[4] calls it 'a genuine coin-flip'.
audit.why: Kayle's autos are melee until 6 while Acceleration Gate-empowered Shock Blast pokes from well outside them; from 4-5 her W sustain and Radiant Blast shred pull it level, and 6 is a coin-flip, not a loss.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 flipped in both layers as one atomic group to Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Skill — giving Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, exactly what the Jayce-side audit settled on — with ratings moved and all four phases[].why lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet counts one sequencing cue on the page. Shock Blast is named as the tracked cooldown in eleven places with no number, and the level-6 phase gave none for Divine Judgment.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6 — 16s at rank 1 is a genuinely long window to farm in, and it shortens fast as he ranks it, which is why the number matters more than the instruction. Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 16s written into dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t; 160s into phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions that the weapon swap is on a 6s cooldown and resets his auto-attack — so the reader has no tell for when the hammer burst is starting, and no sense of how often he can rotate stances.
audit.why: Riot's text: the first attack in cannon form also shreds armour and MR. The swap animation, not the ability cast, is the cue to step out of range.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now states the 6s swap and that it resets his auto.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Save Divine Judgment' in mid; Divine Judgment is Kayle's real R name, so it is a false positive.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Jayce's Shock Blast is down.
edits.after: Acceleration Gate-empowered Shock Blast beats your one point of W heal — concede the trade and last-hit.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Jayce must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full Shock Blast combo online while your autos are still melee — he zones you off CS and chunks you for free.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shock Blast's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: W heal and Radiant Blast's armour shred stabilise you, but his cannon Q still out-pokes — even here, so farm and never all-in.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Jayce's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent gives ranged AoE autos and Divine Judgment (160s) covers his all-in, but his cannon range keeps it a genuine coin-flip.

edits.before: His main poke. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 — step up only when it is down.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1; his 6s swap resets his auto. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — E-poke + scale.
edits.after: Track Shock Blast (16s): his poke, and it is dodgeable. When down — E-poke and scale.

notes: Rows 1-4 flipped as one atomic group so both directions read Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle — what the Jayce-side audit settled on and what this page's own prose already described. Shock Blast's cooldown halves from 16s to 6s across ranks, so the rank-1 number is stated explicitly rather than left as 'his cooldown'. The weapon swap being a 6s auto reset is new to the page. The content layer here does name Kayle's abilities (Radiant Blast, Starfire, Divine Ascent, Divine Judgment), unlike the Jayce-side page the mirror audited.
